title: Profinite equal-image Cech tuples and coordinate deletion
statement: Let $T,V$ be profinite sets, meaning compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological spaces, and let $q:T\to V$ be any continuous map. For each integer $r\geq0$, define the equal-image tuple space $T_V^r=\{t:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to T\mid q(t_i)=q(t_j)\text{ for all }i,j\}$ with the subspace topology from the finite product $T^r$. For $j\in\{0,\ldots,r\}$ define coordinate deletion $\delta_j:T_V^{r+1}\to T_V^r$ by $(\delta_j t)_i=t_i$ when $i<j$ and $(\delta_j t)_i=t_{i+1}$ when $i\geq j$. No surjectivity or nonemptiness is required. For $r=0$ the tuple space has the unique empty tuple and its equality condition is vacuous.
